sourceDeclaration: Pengguna menyatakan bahwa 120 foto dataset adalah foto barang nyata dengan objek berbeda antar-ID. Tambahan 40 foto drywall dan CT-009 sampai CT-012 dinyatakan sebagai papan gipsum berlapis kertas dengan objek berbeda, bukan papan semen. Deklarasi bahan, asal, dan independensi belum diverifikasi.

declaration.statement: Pengguna menyatakan bahwa 120 foto dataset adalah foto barang nyata dengan objek berbeda antar-ID. Tambahan 40 foto drywall dan CT-009 sampai CT-012 dinyatakan sebagai papan gipsum berlapis kertas dengan objek berbeda, bukan papan semen. Deklarasi bahan, asal, dan independensi belum diverifikasi.

datasetSplit.method: Preserve all 52 PET/cardboard training IDs and 28 test IDs; all their tests are now regression. Rank drywall IDs 001-040 by SHA-256 of 20261026:<sample-id>; first 26 train, remaining 14 new holdouts.

architecture: Frozen ImageNet MobileNetV1 0.25 + global average pooling + L2-normalized features + trained three-class softmax head
preprocessing: RGB, bilinear 224x224 with aligned corners, pixel / 127.5 - 1, global average pooling, L2 normalization

training.validationSet: No separate validation set; hyperparameters retained from the previous model, without tuning against either held-out cohort. The previous-test cohort had already been evaluated before this update.

limitations: Only 120 user-supplied source photos; all 14 new holdouts are drywall, while all 28 PET/cardboard test photos have previously been evaluated.
The balanced 42-image combined confusion matrix mixes new and regression evidence; it is not 42 newly unseen test objects.
The new cohort contains no PET/cardboard reference images and cannot establish full three-class precision or general accuracy.
Sample independence, physical material labels and photo origin are user declarations, not independently verified.
The classifier only compares PET-bottle, cardboard and paper-faced drywall classes; unrelated objects or cement board can receive a misleading high score.
Model scores are not calibrated probabilities or measured accuracy on real-world deployment.
Material confirmation, physical weight measurement and sourced carbon factors remain separate requirements.
